title: Astro Portal API v1 — the check before an upload
description: `POST /v1/uploads/check` (a device token or the web session with its CSRF token) takes an upload's declared metadata (`uploadMetadata` of capture.schema.json: `sha256`, `byteSize`, `originalName`, the optional `captureId`, `targetId`/`targetIds`, `sessionId`, `planId`, `source`) and answers before a single byte is sent: `present` (the space already holds these bytes, as the image `imageId` of the capture `captureId` (`main`: its main image) or as the file `attachmentId` attached to it; an upload would store nothing), `accepted` (as a new capture, `adds: capture`, or as an image of `captureId`, `adds: variant`, or as a progression image of `captureId`, `adds: progression`, or as a file attached to `captureId`, `adds: attachment`), or `refused` with the code and the numbers the upload itself would answer. Nothing is written. A malformed body, an unknown or foreign capture, plan, session or target are errors, as for the upload (`400`, `404`). See api/uploads.md, « Checking before sending ».

storage.description: The storage of capture.schema.json, plus `variantLimit` (`capture.variant_limit`) and, for a variant added to `captureId`, `variantCount` (its variants besides the main image).

present.description: The space already holds these bytes as the image `imageId` of `captureId` (`main`: its main image).

presentAttachment.description: The space already holds these bytes as the file `attachmentId` attached to `captureId` (capture-attachment.schema.json), whatever the upload declares.

replacesImageId.description: Additive, with `adds: variant` only: the variant of `captureId` the upload would take the place of (`replacesSha256` naming one the capture holds). Absent when the field was not sent or names no variant of the capture (the image would be added).
